race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Race
race.verdict: CRAYONS IN THE SKY made no mistake when justifying odds-on favouritism with a bit in hand over C&D recently and Stephen Thorne's filly can confirm her superiority over Normanton , who showed much more than on debut last time and is open to further improvement. I Ready and Supreme Lord can fight out the minor placings. CRAYONS IN THE SKY NORMANTON (IRE) I READY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Crayons In The Sky (3/1), Normanton (4/1), Supreme Lord (9/2), Scolyer (5/1), I Ready (13/2), Sharpe Ratio (13/2), Matriarchal (10/1), Waysong (25/1), Cafe Oh Lait (25/1), Sonny Hayes (25/1), Palo (33/1)
